arStrings.szText: So many great tales begin with a voyage across the sea. Vasily’s Passage, the Crusade of Rakkis... None truly captured the way one’s stomach can heave with every pitch of the waves.
Oh, Amelia... Would it please you that I left my study at last to see the world outside? Or would you resent me for waiting until you and our boy had passed?
Writing is not helping. I only pray we reach Gea Kul intact. Solid ground, fresh air, and soon...a magnificent, dry library.
